subject: Important Update: Changes to Company Policies
body: Dear team members, we wanted to inform you about some recent updates to our company policies. These changes will be effective starting next month and will impact all departments. It is crucial that everyone familiarizes themselves with the new policies to ensure compliance and smooth operations. We will be conducting training sessions next week to explain the changes in detail. Please make sure to attend the sessions assigned to your department. Thank you for your attention and cooperation.
